teeth: frame 0's first byte handed back with its low bit flipped
frame 9, its FCS bad, said to be judged good
bitstream_source: board-8x4-features' Verilog, a68c75ab's (src/ as dd604449's), by make -C icepi REV=v1.3 MHZ=40 (seed 1, 49.10 MHz) on the pc
firmware_sha256: of each python/bench_firmware.py entry as sorted, compact JSON, or of the test/ file, at the run's commit
bench: an Icepi Zero (ECP5 LFE5U-25F) running the chip at 40 MHz on bench carrier v1.2, Pico A as the host on SPI, Pico A's PIO as the 10BASE-T sender on IO0, at 10 Mb/s off its own crystal
scope: each frame's bytes and the receiver's verdict in one run of eth_rx, as Pico A logged them
limits: one run of one board, the ECP5 build of the chip's RTL, not the ASIC

the bitstream is named by its sha256, and its netlist's, built from board-8x4-features' Verilog, a68c75ab's (src/ as dd604449's), by make -C icepi REV=v1.3 MHZ=40 (seed 1, 49.10 MHz) on the pc by the bench's notes, which CI does not rebuild
10 Mb/s is past the analyser, so the log is the run's only record: CI judges its frames again from the bytes it says were sent
the line is Pico A's 3.3 V logic, as a line receiver with squelch would give the chip, not a twisted pair through a transformer
